how.text: How to read this. Survey is today, side by side. Spread, Colour and Editors are the one answer, each drawn in every host. Model is where the code goes, the rename, the one wire change, ideas with verdicts, the seven open calls and the session split. Dark-only, the busk view's vocabulary — the intended pixels, not structure to copy.

q1.text: Open calls 1–7 are on Model. Each is drawn one way; the boards say which.
